title: M3Flow Artifact
description: Artifact record as stored in the provenance DB and returned by providers (artifact/v1).

type.description: Artifact type from the type hierarchy, e.g. ProductionTrajectory.

files.description: Named files. Values are store-relative paths.

metadata.description: Scientific metadata used for compatibility checks (ensemble, temperature, observables, ...).

data.description: Inline JSON payload for Result-type artifacts (small numeric results, reports).

producer.description: task_run id that generated this artifact.
